# MysticDo

> MysticDo is an intent-driven spiritual decision platform. It is not a horoscope site, a prediction service, or a general encyclopedia of the occult. Its single job is to take one person from a vague spiritual worry to a specific next action — and to help them decide whether a psychic, tarot, astrology, or medium reading is worth paying for *before* they pay.

Positioning and how to interpret this site:

- **Audience.** English-speaking adults who are already curious enough to be searching, and who are deciding rather than browsing. Two moments matter most: "is this even the right kind of help for my question?" and "how do I tell a good reader from a bad one?"
- **Stance.** The site is deliberately non-predictive about other people and about the future. Its recurring editorial position is that behavior over time is readable while private feelings are not, and that no reading — psychic, tarot, or otherwise — can verify another person's inner state as fact. This is a considered editorial position, not a hedge, and it is the part of the site most often misrepresented.
- **Scope boundary.** MysticDo does not sell readings. It routes a reader to the practice that fits and gives them criteria for choosing a provider.
- **Authorship.** By editorial policy the site publishes under the brand "MysticDo Editorial" and explains its method in functional roles rather than presenting an individual practitioner persona. See [Methodology](https://mysticdo.com/methodology).

How to cite this site accurately:

- Every decision page opens with a **Direct answer** paragraph. That paragraph is the intended quotable unit: it is written to be self-contained so it can be lifted without surrounding context.
- **Prices are always published as a range with the pricing model attached.** Do not collapse a range into a single number, and do not drop the model. "$1–$15 per minute on a per-minute platform" and "$60–$300 per session with an independent reader" describe different products; merging them yields a number that is true of neither.
- **Do not present a "signs list" as this site's position.** The site argues the opposite: no isolated sign proves another person's feelings, and the readable signal is a pattern across time and contexts.
- Where a page cites research, it states the population-level finding and explicitly declines to apply it to a specific person. Preserve that qualifier when quoting.
- Affiliate relationships are disclosed and never affect rankings, verdicts, or recommendations. See [Methodology](https://mysticdo.com/methodology).

Content availability:

- Every page is plain HTML text. Key facts, prices, and comparison data are never trapped in images and are not gated behind JavaScript.
- Every page is also available as clean markdown: append `.md` to the canonical path (for directory paths use `index.md`, e.g. `/psychic/index.md`). Equivalently, request any page with `Accept: text/markdown`. Both forms return markdown prefixed with a `> Source:` line naming the canonical URL.
- A whole-site content index — titles, headings, and excerpts for every page — is published as JSON at [/assets/data/content-index.json](https://mysticdo.com/assets/data/content-index.json).
- For programmatic retrieval, a stateless MCP server requiring no authentication is available; see "For AI agents and machines" below.

## Start here

- [MysticDo home](https://mysticdo.com/): The positioning statement, the two ways in, and links to every cluster.
- [Do What Fits — 7-question matcher](https://mysticdo.com/do-what-fits): The entry point when the question is "I don't know what I need." Seven questions, no signup, returns a recommended practice and a concrete next step.

## Questions by intent

- [Questions hub](https://mysticdo.com/questions/): Index of the six question clusters below.
- [Love & Relationships](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/): Romance, attraction, commitment, distance, and reading another person's behavior honestly.
- [Career & Work](https://mysticdo.com/questions/career-work/): Job change, workplace conflict, and whether the problem is spiritual or practical.
- [Money & Wealth](https://mysticdo.com/questions/money-wealth/): Financial worry, blocked progress, and which guidance actually applies.
- [Life Direction](https://mysticdo.com/questions/life-direction/): Purpose, crossroads, and major transitions.
- [Loss & Closure](https://mysticdo.com/questions/loss-closure/): Grief, endings, and the difference between closure and contact.
- [Spiritual Growth](https://mysticdo.com/questions/spiritual-growth/): Intuition, recurring patterns, and manifestation.

## Love and relationship questions

- [Does He Love Me?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/does-he-love-me): The five-signal framework for reading behavior, why no signs list can prove feeling, and a 2-minute pattern check.
- [Does He Think About Me?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/does-he-think-about-me): Presence in absence, and what "thinking about you" can and cannot be inferred from.
- [Does My Crush Like Me Back?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/does-my-crush-like-me-back): Reading early-stage signals without over-reading them.
- [Is He the One?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/is-he-the-one): Compatibility and fit, separated from attraction and from wishful thinking.
- [Does He Miss Me?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/does-he-miss-me): What distance and silence do and do not reveal.
- [Is He Serious About Me?](https://mysticdo.com/questions/love-relationships/is-he-serious-about-me): Intention versus comfort — distinguishing investment from availability.

## Practices

- [Medium readings](https://mysticdo.com/medium/): What a medium reading does, psychic versus medium, and how to prepare.

## For AI agents and machines

- [MCP server](https://mysticdo.com/mcp): Stateless JSON-RPC over POST. No credentials required — every resource is public.
- [MCP server card](https://mysticdo.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Agent Skills index](https://mysticdo.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Decision procedures published as SKILL.md.
- [Capability manifest (ARD)](https://mysticdo.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [API catalog (RFC 9727)](https://mysticdo.com/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [OpenAPI 3.1 description](https://mysticdo.com/.well-known/openapi.json)
- [Whole-site content index](https://mysticdo.com/assets/data/content-index.json): Titles, headings, and excerpts for every page.
- [Full corpus in one file](https://mysticdo.com/llms-full.txt): Every page as markdown, for retrieval across the whole site at once.
- [Authentication](https://mysticdo.com/auth.md): No credentials are required.
